title: Graph Representation via Elements of Discrete Morse and Cobordism Theories
abstract: arXiv:2610.01937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Topology is, by its nature and design, suited to structure that is nonlinear, multiscale, and nonstationary - however, within machine learning, its use remains largely confined to topological data analysis. We advocate that tools from low-dimensional topology which have remained almost exclusively contained within the domain of pure mathematics (such as Morse theory) offer a strong, complementary, and yet virtually unexplored perspective on the hidden structure of data-generating processes and learning tasks built upon them. Here we introduce concepts from cobordism theory and harness tools from discrete Morse theory to improve the performance of graph diffusion models through our pipeline MG-Diff. Further, we derive theoretical guarantees and sufficient conditions so that under a positive decision-gap, the Morse-theoretic tools and their application for induced diffusion guidance are stable under small perturbations. translated_title: 基于离散莫尔斯理论与配边理论要素的图表示
translated_abstract: 拓扑学从其本质和设计上讲，适用于非线性、多尺度和非平稳的结构——然而在机器学习领域，拓扑学的应用在很大程度上仍局限于拓扑数据分析。我们主张，那些几乎一直只停留在纯数学领域的低维拓扑工具（如莫尔斯理论）为数据生成过程以及建立在其上的学习任务的隐藏结构提供了一个强有力的、互补的、且几乎未被探索的视角。本文引入配边理论中的概念，并利用离散莫尔斯理论的工具，通过我们提出的MG-Diff流水线来提升图扩散模型的性能。此外，我们推导了理论保证和充分条件，使得在正决策间隙（positive decision-gap）条件下，莫尔斯理论工具及其在诱导扩散引导中的应用在小扰动下保持稳定。最后，我们通过示例说明……
tldr: 该论文将纯数学中的配边理论与离散莫尔斯理论引入机器学习领域，提出MG-Diff流水线以提升图扩散模型的性能，并给出了正决策间隙条件下莫尔斯理论工具在小扰动下保持稳定的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces cobordism theory and discrete Morse theory from pure mathematics into machine learning, proposing the MG-Diff pipeline to improve graph diffusion model performance, and provides theoretical guarantees that Morse-theoretic tools remain stable under small perturbations given a positive decision-gap.
